Wendi [S2 - 3rd] 2026-05-15 12:06 AM
Specs, Aesop. On days like these I question how and why I made it this far. In the other orgs I have played, I did poorly, 24/30, 23/24, 71/100. I dont what I did differently. I stay up asking myself if I deserve to be here, did the likes of henke and times, celestial and Lucas, Archangel and Harpy deserve to be here more than me. Ive never been able to find a true answer. I flip back and forth on the matter hourly, leaving it up to the depths of my mind to make itself up in the immediate. They say that pessimism is the killer of success so why am I here. Almost everytime I've thought that something would go wrong. That I misplaced and wasn't good enough. And yet, Im still here. Was it luck, was it the abilities, was it the people around me, did I play good or did they just play bad. These questions seem to plague me in my dreams, and in my waking hours. This leads into the main reason I write this message. Ive never been in jury, never into merge, barely into a swap, let alone a ftc. What will happen if my thoughts are true. If I wasn't ever good enough and go into ftc hopes high only for them to be sent down. How will I handle it. Im not the most emotionally stable person, I come from a family of mental and emotional conditions and me myself have a plethora of depression and anxiety based disorders. Ive brushed with death on more than one occasion not just in a way of wondering or thinking but to the point of hospitalization after failure. How will I react if/when I lose. Will it be bittersweet, a burden off my shoulder, or will it be the push off the cliff ive been edging closer to for years. I considered walking in the past, choosing to leave by my own accords, not wanting to feel the sting and yet its too late for that, I've made my choice, and I have to commit it to the end.
